name: com.oxfordledge/oxford-ledge
title: Oxford Ledge
description: Ask your assistant; it reads the public record: SEC filings, 13F, insider trades, BDC loans.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional. An ol_live_ key from https://www.oxfordledge.com/mcp#get-your-key. Without it the anonymous tools answer; with it, the tools your plan's tier allows.

environmentVariables.name: OXFORD_LEDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Set to https://www.oxfordledge.com to reach the hosted data. Without it only the standalone SEC-EDGAR and FRED tools answer.

environmentVariables.name: OXFORD_LEDGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional ol_live_ key from https://www.oxfordledge.com/mcp#get-your-key; needed only for the Researcher-tier tools.

environmentVariables.name: FRED_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional free FRED key; enables the standalone FRED tools.
